title: TheQuestForge
description: This mod adds a quest system to the game.
body:
This mod adds a full-fledged quest system to the game!

**This mod does not add any quests on its own; you need to add the data pack for that!**

[Standart data pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/standart-quest-pack)

***

**The mod has its own wiki page for a full exploration of its features.** It contains information on:

*   How to make a mob a quest giver.
*   How to add a quest.
*   As a group for rewards and tasks.
*   A tool for creating quests.
*   The mod API.

***

Now, after installing the mod and adding quests, quest-giving entities will appear throughout the world to issue quests. Currently available:

*   Kill
*   Collect

But the list will be expanded!

All aspects can be customized or edited, and quests, tasks, rewards, and quest givers are editable via JSON files in data packs.

You can also use mobs, items, and buildings from other mods to create top-notch quests.

Quest chains are also available, allowing you to create an entire storyline!

***

Does the mod have plans to expand and improve its functionality? If you have any ideas, suggestions, or bug reports, please post them on GitHub
